places.name: Palace of the Parliament
places.ai_summary: The Palace of the Parliament is the heaviest building in the world, showcasing grand architecture and Romania’s political history.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available.

places.place_tip: Book tickets in advance for guided tours.

places.name: Old Town (Lipscani District)
places.ai_summary: The Old Town is a lively area filled with historic buildings, cafes, and nightlife, offering a glimpse into Bucharest’s past.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening.

places.place_tip: Explore the side streets for hidden gems.

attribution.title: Strada Covaci
attribution.author: Mihai Petre

places.name: Romanian Athenaeum
places.ai_summary: The Romanian Athenaeum is a concert hall in Bucharest, known for its stunning architecture and as a center of Romanian culture.

opening_hours.notes: Check schedule for concert timings.

places.place_tip: Attend a concert for a complete experience.

places.name: Revolution Square
places.ai_summary: Revolution Square is a historical site in Bucharest, representing the place where the Romanian Revolution of 1989 took place.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby museums for more history.

places.name: Calea Victoriei Avenue
places.ai_summary: Calea Victoriei is one of Bucharest’s most important avenues, featuring historical buildings, shops, and cafes.

opening_hours.notes: Great for a leisurely walk.

places.place_tip: Try the local cafes along the avenue.

places.name: National Museum of Art of Romania
places.ai_summary: The National Museum of Art of Romania houses an extensive collection of modern and contemporary Romanian art.
places.name_english: National Museum of Art of Romania

opening_hours.notes: Free entry on the first Wednesday of each month.

places.place_tip: Check for temporary exhibitions.

places.name: Village Museum (Muzeul Satului)
places.ai_summary: The Village Museum is an open-air museum showcasing traditional Romanian village life and architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available in English and Romanian.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for walking.

places.name: National History Museum
places.ai_summary: The National History Museum offers a comprehensive overview of Romanian history from prehistoric to modern times.

opening_hours.notes: Free entry on the first Sunday of each month.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the Romanian Crown Jewels exhibit.

places.name: Stavropoleos Monastery Church
places.ai_summary: Stavropoleos Monastery Church is a small, historic church in Bucharest, known for its beautiful frescoes and peaceful courtyard.

opening_hours.notes: Respect the dress code: no shorts or sleeveless tops.

places.place_tip: Visit the gift shop for unique souvenirs.

places.name: Herastrau Park & Lake
places.ai_summary: Herastrau Park is the largest park in Bucharest, featuring a lake, walking trails, and recreational activities.

opening_hours.notes: Rent a bike or boat for more fun.

places.place_tip: Pack a picnic and enjoy by the lake.

places.name: Arcul de Triumf
places.ai_summary: The Arch of Triumph is a monument in Bucharest, honoring the Romanian soldiers who fought in World War I.

opening_hours.notes: Climb to the top for a great view.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby Victory Square.
places.address: Piața Arcul de Triumf, Bucharest, Romania

places.name: University Square
places.ai_summary: University Square is a central square in Bucharest, surrounded by important cultural and educational institutions.

opening_hours.notes: Visit the University of Bucharest.

places.place_tip: Check out the bookstores and cafes.

places.name: Carol Park & Mausoleum
places.ai_summary: Carol Park is a large public park in Bucharest, featuring a mausoleum, a lake, and beautiful gardens.

opening_hours.notes: Visit the mausoleum for a small fee.

places.place_tip: Explore the park’s trails and monuments.

places.name: Cotroceni Palace & Museum
places.ai_summary: Cotroceni Palace is the official residence of the President of Romania, featuring a museum and beautiful gardens.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available in English and Romanian.

places.place_tip: Book a guided tour for detailed insights.

places.name: Romanian Peasant Museum
places.ai_summary: The Romanian Peasant Museum showcases the art, culture, and traditions of the Romanian people.

opening_hours.notes: Free entry on the first Monday of each month.

places.place_tip: Visit the museum shop for traditional crafts.

places.name: Dambovita Riverside Walk
places.ai_summary: The Dambovita Riverside Walk is a scenic promenade along the Dambovita River, ideal for walking, jogging, and cycling.

opening_hours.notes: Well-lit and safe for evening walks.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a boat ride on the river.

attribution.description: The unfinished Casa Radio, Bucharest, Romania; this enormous concrete hulk has remained in roughly this state since the Revolution of 1989.

places.name: Patriarchal Cathedral Hill
places.ai_summary: Patriarchal Cathedral Hill is a historic and religious site in Bucharest, offering panoramic views of the city.

opening_hours.notes: Visit the Patriarchal Cathedral inside the complex.

places.place_tip: Dress modestly when visiting the cathedral.
places.address: Strada Mitropolit Antim Ivireanu 24, Bucharest, Romania

places.name: Cismigiu Gardens
places.ai_summary: Cismigiu Gardens is a public park in Bucharest, featuring beautiful gardens, a lake, and recreational facilities.

opening_hours.notes: Rent a boat or bike for more fun.

places.place_tip: Visit the flowerbeds and the lake island.

places.name: Snagov Monastery (Vlad the Impaler’s Tomb)
places.ai_summary: Snagov Monastery is a historic monastery located on an island in Snagov Lake, reputed to be the burial site of Vlad the Impaler.

opening_hours.notes: Access by boat or car via a dam.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to Snagov Lake.

places.name: Bucharest Fountains Show
places.ai_summary: The Bucharest Fountains Show is a spectacular display of water, light, and music, held at the Unirii Square.

opening_hours.notes: Check the schedule for show timings.

places.place_tip: Arrive early for a good viewing spot.
